entities.name: Huerty Kostambul
entities.description: Loxodon commandant of the Rundlestrom Military Academy on Arcavios, authoritarian and vindictive, who expelled Quintorius Kand.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Student who defended himself against hazing by three cadets and was interrogated, threatened and expelled by Kostambul.

entities.name: Rundlestrom Military Academy
entities.description: Military academy on Arcavios led by Huerty Kostambul.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane on which the Rundlestrom Military Academy lies.

events.summary: Kostambul interrogates and threatens Quint after Quint defends himself against hazing by three cadets using magic, and expels him from the Academy.
events.quote: His encounter with Quint, where he interrogated and threatened him after Quint defended himself against hazing by three cadets

relations.note: He is the loxodon leader of the academy.
relations.quote: Huerty Kostambul is the loxodon leader of the Rundlestrom Military Academy on Arcavios

relations.note: Kostambul expelled Quint and threatened him.
relations.quote: responsible for expelling Quintorius Kand from the Academy
